description: This is a PHP source file that defines an API endpoint class 'EmployeeLatestAttendanceRecordAPI' within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides functionality to retrieve the latest attendance record for a specified employee or the authenticated user if no employee number is provided. It leverages traits for attendance service and authentication, and follows the structure of a RESTful API with method implementations for GET requests.
